question:
**Direction: Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The old building was **__damolished__** to make way for a new building.
solution:
The correct answer is **"demolished."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is** "demolished."**
 
• It means to destroy something, for example a building. ((भवन आदि को) गिरा देना, तोड़
